source_evidence: An easy way to do this is to have your bank automatically deposit money from your paycheck into a savings or investment account.
question: Misconception: Paying yourself first means waiting until the end of the month and saving whatever money is left over.
answer: Correction: The source describes paying yourself first as a way to build a saving and investing habit. One easy approach is to arrange for part of your paycheck to be deposited automatically into a savings or investment account.
